steps.text: Assets like the Dollar and Gold move inversely. If you see them moving in the same direction by mistake, a "Divergence" has occurred, and that's the opportunity!

quiz.question: What is the relationship between Dollar and Gold?

steps.text: When the Dollar makes a new high, but Gold doesn't make a new low... it means one of them is lying! Divergence is the lie detector.

quiz.question: What exactly does divergence detect?
options: One of the assets is lying

lessons.title: Premium & Discount Zones
lessons.subtitle: Where to buy and where to sell

steps.text: Where to buy? In the Discount zone — below 50% Fibonacci. Where to sell? In the Premium zone — above 50% Fibonacci. Banks buy from you in discount and sell to you in premium. Don't be the retail trader who buys high and sells low!

When you find divergence between two assets in the discount zone — that's a strong buy signal. When divergence happens in the premium zone — that's a sell signal. Combining SMT with Fibonacci gives you very precise targets.

quiz.question: Discount zone is below what Fibonacci level?
Divergence in discount zone gives what signal?

steps.text: Don't trade on just one timeframe! The higher timeframe (Weekly/Daily) gives you the overall trend. The medium timeframe (4H/1H) gives you supply and demand zones. The lower timeframe (15M/5M) gives you the entry point. When SMT divergence appears on multiple timeframes — that's the strongest signal!
Move between timeframes: zoom out to see the big picture, zoom in for the precise entry!
